title: Tags and Filters
description: Organize and find notes using tags and advanced filters

steps.title: Adding Tags
steps.description: Type #tagname in any note to create a tag. Tags are autocomplete-enabled.

steps.title: Add a Tag
steps.description: Open a note and type #project-alpha in the content

steps.title: Filter Bar
steps.description: Use the filter bar at the top of notes view to filter by tags, properties, date ranges, and more.

steps.title: Filter by Tag
steps.description: Click the tag filter and select 'project-alpha'

steps.title: Saved Views
steps.description: Save complex filter combinations as named views for quick access from the sidebar.

steps.title: Save Current View
steps.description: Click 'Save View' and name it 'Project Alpha Notes'
